init_ArticulatedAgentAction: create an ArticulatedAgentAction that routes actions to a specific articulated agent by parsing the agent index from the action name
property_articulated_agent_mgr: access the articulated agent manager for a specific agent instance via the _articulated_agent_mgr property
property_ik_helper: retrieve the inverse kinematics helper for an articulated agent instance using the _ik_helper property
property_cur_articulated_agent: get the current articulated agent instance for this action via the cur_articulated_agent property
property_action_arg_prefix: obtain the multi-agent action prefix string for sensor and action naming using the _action_arg_prefix property
